fetch_web_page_content: fetch the contents of a web page at a given URL using the web_fetch_tool and return markdown text
crawl_url_with_jina: crawl a URL using JinaClient.crawl to retrieve HTML or other format content from the Jina API
extract_article_from_html: extract article title and content from raw HTML using ReadabilityExtractor.extract_article
convert_article_to_markdown: convert an Article object to markdown format using Article.to_markdown
convert_article_to_message: convert an Article object to a list of text and image_url message parts using Article.to_message
